lead_headline: Kaş and Kalkan Villa Tourism Sees Summer Activity
lead_deck: Villa rental demands in the region have increased with the start of the summer season.
lead_body: Villa tourism in the Kaş and Kalkan regions is experiencing intense activity with the arrival of summer.
This increase observed in accommodation facilities is giving momentum to regional tourism.

col3_title: Villa Tourism to Peak in July
col3_body: It is expected that accommodation demands will reach their highest level in July.
